work.name: Oracle local semantic execution
work.decision: Freeze task/frame/model and establish reproducible oracle local-execution fidelity before revision, topology, batching or scale.
work.reroute: If oracle-frame execution fails, retain the failure and repair operator/readout; downstream work cannot rescue it.

work.name: Counterexample candidate revision
work.decision: After a viable W1 condition, compare a candidate set that includes first-class NO_CHANGE, evidence-only and sham arms against sealed outcomes; analyze every assigned world intent-to-treat, not only field-distinct candidates.
work.reroute: No semantic delta or no fresh-case difference is a preserved negative, not a learning result.

work.name: Active local reads
work.decision: After W1 readiness and W2's learning-claim boundary, compare full, fixed and active actual reads with the same admissible information and total-cost budget; candidate recall and hidden-outcome leakage are separate checks.
work.reroute: If a local frame aliases states or active reads have no held-out value, expand the declared frame or retire that read policy.

work.name: Joint law execution
work.decision: After W1, W2 and W3 conditions, test role-bearing joint candidates and explicit factorization against exclusion/complementarity constraints before claiming batched/shared execution.
work.reroute: If marginals or batching violate the joint law, retain the failure and use joint candidates or staged execution.

work.name: Recursive composition
work.decision: After W2 and W4 conditions, test the same Step/Learn/outcome/lineage and exit contracts at lower and upper scale.
work.reroute: If composition loses intervention effect, lineage or permissions, revise the mechanism; do not call nesting scale closure.
